project_type: Next.js 16 app with App Router, React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS v4
build_system: bun (no npm/node) - run via bun run <script>
test_framework: vitest with path aliases - tests in src/**/*.test.ts
verification_instructions: 1. bun run tsc --noEmit (TypeScript checks), 2. bun run vitest --run (6 test files pass, 1 pre-existing env.test.ts failure due to zod v4 is acceptable)
setup_instructions: bun install --ignore-scripts (already installed). All deps pre-installed: recharts, lucide-react, framer-motion, tailwindcss
environment_constraints: INTEGRATIONS_ONLY - no external npm installs. All packages already available. No Docker daemon. Use bun exclusively (no npm/node).
contribution_requirements: Feature-based folders (src/features/{name}/). No cross-feature imports (use src/shared/). localStorage for user data. Never use useSyncExternalStore for one-time reads. Never call router.push() during render. Use CSS variables for theming.
key_patterns: Components are 'use client' with useState(() => ...) lazy initializer for localStorage reads. Recharts uses dynamic imports with ssr:false for charts. Types/utils/components pattern per feature. PracticeAttempt (types/attempt.ts) and QuestionSession (types/index.ts) are two data models. Data flows from attempt-storage.ts and session-storage.ts (localStorage). CFA_SUBJECTS_ORDERED from shared/config/subjects.ts. Colors: Navy #002B5C, Gold #C5A258, Green #00843D, BG #0a0e14. CSS vars: --card-bg, --card-border, --foreground, --foreground-secondary, --accent-primary, --accent-success, --accent-secondary.
directory_structure: src/features/{name}/ - feature folders with components/types/utils/hooks. src/shared/ - shared config/components/hooks/lib/types. src/app/(protected)/ - Next.js App Router pages. Question data in src/features/question-bank/data/. Tests in src/features/**/__tests__/.
